pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #2985 

## What does this PR do?

### User standpoint

- Allows importing dumps version 1 (exported with Meilisearch <=v0.20) to modern-day Meilisearch
- Tasks of type "Customs" are skipped, with a warning
- Tasks of status "enqueued" are skipped, with a warning
- The "WordsPosition" ranking rule is skipped when encountered in the ranking rules, with a warning.

After an import from a v1 dump, it is recommended that a user checks each index and its settings.

### Implementation standpoint

- Add a dump v1 reader based on the one by @irevoire 
- Add a v1_to_v2 compatibility layer based on the v2_to_v3 one
  - as v2 requires UUIDs, the v1 indexes are mapped to UUIDs built from their position in the metada file: the first index is given UUID all zeroes, the second one UUID `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`, and so on... This should have no bearing on the final indexes because v6 is not using UUIDs, but this allows us to correctly identify which tasks belong to which index.
- Modify the v2_to_v3 compatibility layer to account for the fact that the reader can actually be a v1_to_v2 compat layer
- Make some base dump types Clone
- impl Display for v2::settings::Criterion

## PR checklist
Please check if your PR fulfills the following requirements:
- [x] Does this PR fix an existing issue, or have you listed the changes applied in the PR description (and why they are needed)?
- [x] Have you read the contributing guidelines?
- [x] Have you made sure that the title is accurate and descriptive of the changes?

Thank you so much for contributing to Meilisearch!

issue_context.title: Add the support of the dump v1 (Meilisearch v0.20.0 and before)
issue_context.body:
Currently, users using Meilisearch v0.20.0 and before need to do TWO migrations to upgrade Meilisearch to v0.30.0. [See the related documentation](https://docs.meilisearch.com/learn/advanced/updating.html#update-to-the-latest-meilisearch-version).

This is due to the fact we dropped the support of dump v1 some releases ago.

It means it will not be easy for all our users to pass from their current version to v1. This is something we would like to avoid because in the best-case scenario, all the Meilisearch users will use Meilisearch v1.0.0 and after.

We would like to re-introduce the dump v1 support of Meilisearch to ensure people using Meilisearch v0.20.0 and before can migrate to Meilisearch v1.0.0 in one migration and not two.

## Impacted teams

@meilisearch/docs-team @meilisearch/integration-team

comments: Started work on this today, made a reader of dumps v1, am doing a compat layers with dumps v2

Draft PR open: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/3170

Need to fix the tests, add some more tests, add description and so on.

Thanks @dureuill 🎉 👏 
Don't forget the step about updating the specification, I put the link of the related spec in the issue 😄

While I'm at it, some of the current "quirks" of the import from the dumps v1, caused by the format being so much older than the current v6 dump format, and that the documentation might want to keep in mind when updating the documentation of the dump feature:

- Tasks that are in the "enqueued" (not "processed" or "failed") status in the exported dump will not be imported (they will be missing from the task log, and won't be restarted). Technically, this is because we don't have the required data to resume the task. The recommendation for users to avoid any data loss is to make sure that all tasks of their Meilisearch <v20.0 are fully processed before exporting the database to a dump.
- Processed tasks that are of the type "Customs" in the exported dump will not be imported (they will be missing from the task log). Technically, this is because we don't have a similar task type in dumps v2 and superior (Meilisearch 0.21 and superior). This has no bearing on the actual document data in the imported DB so there is no special recommendation for users.
- The number of documents that were deleted by a clearAll command is unavailable in the task logs of dumps v1. In the imported DB, the number of deleted documents for these tasks will read "0" instead of the correct number. This is only for the task log and has no bearing on the actual documents contained in the imported DB (which are the same as the documents that were contained in the exported DB).
- There is no DB creation date available for dumps v1, so this information will be missing for databases imported from dumps that were exported from Meilisearch <=v0.20 (I'm unsure what it is used for atm though)
